About Organization

Integral Coach Factory ICF is a manufacturer of rail coaches located in Chennai, India. It was established in 1955 and is owned and operated by Indian Railways.
As per official notification, ICF is responsible for the production of rail coaches and other related products.

About the Programme

The Integral Coach Factory ICF Apprentices programme is an apprenticeship training programme offered by ICF to eligible candidates. The programme aims to provide training to candidates in various trades and skills.
The programme is open to Indian nationals who meet the eligibility criteria. The selection process involves a merit-based selection.
